the host granite and the talus, boulders and soil on it. Topaz grows in the cavities with smoky quartz and pink feldspar (Boggs 1985): look for broken cavity walls on the blocks below the cliffs, then pan or screen the soil; topaz is heavy and stays in the pan (SG 3.49-3.57, Handbook of Mineralogy). A big area: start at the road point and work outward.
